description: React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4 UI library built for AI coding agents. One typed theme file sets the look; forms, data tables, app layout, charts, auth and file viewers come solved. Ships an MCP server (@glyphui/mcp) and llms.txt.
rules: Look up a component's props and import entry before using it; with the glyph MCP server, call get_component. Don't guess props.
Import from the entry each component lists, such as @glyphui/ui/form or @glyphui/ui/data-table, not always @glyphui/ui.
Import @glyphui/ui/fonts.css, then tailwindcss, then @glyphui/ui/styles.css in the app's CSS, and wrap the app in <GlyphProvider>.
Style through the theme file (defineTheme) and token utilities such as bg-primary and text-muted-foreground, not hard-coded colors.
Prefer an existing pattern or block (Form, DataTable, AppShell, @glyphui/blocks) over rebuilding it from primitives.
Keep all @glyphui/* packages on the same version.
